memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent with ADLs, uses a walking stick for outdoor walks. reports mild knee discomfort but manages household chores.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal). no immediate concern for dementia.
falls: zero falls in past 12 months. gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal). fall risk low; advise regular strength exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 0 regular (currently none). polypharmacy not applicable.
mood: denies low mood or anxiety; reports occasional irritability linked to headache.
carers: son, Vivek, provides weekly grocery assistance.
goal: "I want to stay active and keep my headaches under control so I can continue my small contracts."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting lipid profile: total cholesterol 210 mg/dL (<200 desirable), LDL 130 mg/dL (<100), HDL 38 mg/dL (>40 low), triglycerides 165 mg/dL (<150).
Fasting glucose: 102 mg/dL (70-99).
HbA1c: 6.0% (4.0-5.6).
Liver function: ALT 28 U/L (7-56), AST 24 U/L (10-40), ALP 78 U/L (40-129), GGT 32 U/L (9-64), bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (0.2-1.2).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
propranolol 40 mg oral once daily
sumatriptan 50 mg oral as needed for migraine (max 2 doses/24h)
topiramate 25 mg oral at bedtime
naproxen 500 mg oral as needed for pain (max 1g/day)
orlistat 120 mg oral with each main meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner)

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: still independent; reports using stick less often, knee pain improved with weight loss attempt.
cognition: Mini-Cog repeated 4/5; stable.
falls: zero falls in past year. gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds. fall risk low; continue ankle‑strength exercises.
medicines: 5 regular (propranolol, topiramate, sumatriptan prn, naproxen prn, orlistat). polypharmacy present – request review against Beers criteria.
mood: denies depression; occasional frustration when headache breakthrough.
carers: son Vivek, assists with medication pick‑up.
goal: "I’d like fewer migraine days and to keep my weight down for easier work on site."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: ADLs independent; reports occasional mild knee ache after long walks.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5; unchanged.
falls: one minor slip at home 3 months ago, no injury. gait slightly cautious, timed up-and-go 11 seconds (borderline raised risk). advise balance training, proper footwear, home hazard check.
medicines: 5 regular (propranolol 60 mg, topiramate 50 mg, sumatriptan prn, naproxen prn, orlistat). polypharmacy – note for Beers review.
mood: reports feeling better; denies depression.
carers: son Vivek, helps with grocery and medication.
goal: "I want to stay steady on my feet and keep headaches rare so I can keep taking small contracts."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: 12-lead ECG: sinus rhythm 72 bpm, no ST‑T changes, no Q waves, left ventricular voltage normal. No evidence of ischemia or arrhythmia.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: "I’ve felt light‑headed when I stand up quickly after sitting, especially in the mornings. It passes after a few seconds."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:

cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5; stable.
falls: zero falls in past year. gait normal, timed up‑and‑go 10 seconds. fall risk low; continue calf‑strength exercises.
medicines: 5 regular (propranolol 60 mg, topiramate 25 mg, sumatriptan prn, naproxen prn, orlistat). polypharmacy – flag for Beers review.
mood: denies depression; notes mild anxiety about light‑headedness.
carers: son Vivek, assists with transport to clinic.
goal: "I’d like the dizziness to go away and keep my headaches under control."

memories.text:
